caption: The drawing consists of a central heart-shaped area filled with dense black calligraphic text. Surrounding this heart, there are stylized floral motifs and blooming pomegranate-like flowers, colored mainly in red, blue, yellow, and green. The flowers are attached to green leafy vines that extend symmetrically from the edges towards the center. In each corner of the rectangular composition, there are radiating button-like flowers with alternating yellow, red, and blue petals. At the top center, above the heart, there is a small bird, primarily blue and tan in color, perched next to another small patch of black calligraphic text placed within a scalloped-edged yellow and red cartouche. The background is a plain, light beige, and the entire drawing is bordered by a thick, double black line forming a rectangular frame. The composition is symmetrical with repeated floral and leafy elements distributed evenly around the heart.
title: Certificate, Birth and Baptismal; (Fractur)
